injuries.detail: Bassey is probable for Friday's game against the Spurs due to left toe soreness.
Curry has been diagnosed with an oblique abdominal tear and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
Williams (hamstring) will miss at least one week, per Anthony Slater of ESPN.com.
Porzingis announced on his social media that he's stepping away from basketball.
Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN rep
Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.
Vassell is questionable for Friday's game against the Warriors due to left adductor tightness.
Fox is questionable for Friday's game against the Warriors due to left hip soreness.
Harris (calf) is out for Wednesday's game against Chicago, Jared Weiss of The Athletic reports.
Quaintance has been around the team but has not yet been cleared for basketball activities, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.
